script: The source argues old instructions can hold newer models back. Rules for retired models pile up.
Check twice. Plan every step. That extra work slows the race.
Remove repeated checks. Stop shouting commands. Cut unnecessary steps.
Review changes. Nothing applies without permission.
One developer reports seventy improvements across three files.
A cited test claims nine percent lower cost, and roughly two points more accuracy on the same model.
